title: Bajali district
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Bajali district, in Lower Assam, was formed in 2020 from Barpeta district. Its headquarters is Pathsala town, on the Guwahati–Barpeta road.

Life

Bajali is a small, largely agricultural district, with rice, jute and mustard farming, and bamboo and cane crafts in its villages. Pathsala is its commercial and educational centre.
